articles.title: A Spy Spoof With a Grain of Truth

The mountains, rivers and indigenous games around her showed her how a people holds itself together.

Born on the first day of National Women's Month, she was raised by her grandmothers, Sphiwe and Rhoda Mavundla, after her mother fled when she was two months old. Mavundla later added her grandmother's name, Sphiwe, and her mother's name, Nomusa, to her ID.

articles.dek: Felicia Naiwa Sithebe, the co-founder of Actor Spaces, grew up in a big family in Migson Manor, near Lenasia South. Sithebe's work involves aligning the Actor Spaces team across casting, its academy, digital platforms and events.

articles.title: Logie Soobramoney
articles.dek: When Logie Soobramoney looks back at her life, she is sometimes amazed by how far she has come. She grew up on a farm near Port Shepstone in KwaZulu-Natal, where life was simple and there was no electricity until she was 20.She studied for her matric exams by paraffin lamp.
